secondary.use: Codex lane for clear-spec execution, independent review, computer use, and token-heavy mechanical work.

hard.selection: Use the smallest effort that clears the context-ablation quality gate.

ultra.use: Independent lanes only; never silently create an agent team.

ui_policy.fallback_rule: Use Astra for user-facing work only when no Claude owner is available, and name the fallback.

chores.use: Tiny edits, clean rebases, mechanical CI fixes, and read-only retrieval or listing such as email or daily task lists.
chores.escalate: Move to Sol on rebase conflicts, CI failures that need diagnosis, or any judgment call; if Luna is unavailable, run the chore inline on the owner at low effort.

review.secondary_use: Add an Opus pass when Astra is unavailable or the PR needs evidence-heavy, actionable findings.

escalation.rule: Raise Astra to xhigh for PR reviews only when a host meter or the user shows at least 50% Codex usage remaining; unknown usage stays at high.

efforts.reason: Owner rule: max is for benchmarking only; the benchmark suites may still sweep it, routing never selects it.

claude-opus-5-5.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.

gpt-6-sol.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.
gpt-6-sol.unavailable: Use gpt-6-astra at high and name the fallback; never a cheaper GPT model.

gpt-6-astra.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.

claude-fable-5-1.use: Only on explicit user request for extraordinary work, such as powering through a hard feature. Never above high effort.

selection.fallback: Keep one owner. A different-family pass requires explicit delegation.
selection.promotion_rule: Promote a model, effort, or context variant only after it passes the versioned ablation gate.

api_only.pro_mode: Available through the API; do not imply that a local CLI session uses it.
api_only.persistence_and_ptc: Use persisted reasoning or programmatic tool calling only in an API harness that exposes them.
api_only.explicit_prompt_cache: Use only in API integrations that expose cache controls.

scoring.cost: Artificial Analysis cost per Intelligence Index task at the routed effort, log scale; cheapest is 10.
scoring.intelligence: Peak Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; 58 is 10 and 30 is 1.
scoring.speed: Median output tokens per second relative to the fastest model.
scoring.taste: Owner judgment for UI/UX, code quality, API design, and copy.
scoring.order: Shipped work weighs intelligence, then taste, then cost; cost only breaks ties.
scoring.review: Orchestrator V2 audit panel (T3 Code PR #2829, 2026-09-24) weighted mean relative to the leader (Astra 8.22 = 10); Luna was not measured and does not review.
scoring.allowance: How long the $200 plan lasts before a limit hits (Claude Max 20x, ChatGPT Pro 20x). Codex: published per-5-hour Pro 20x ranges (Astra 100-900, Sol 300-3,000, Luna 7,000-56,000), log scale. Claude publishes no counts: Opus 5.5 is the owner's observed most generous; Fable 5.1 draws limits faster (list price 2.5x Opus 5.5) and is capped at 50% of the weekly limit.
